body:
Saw your in-progress induce.scala change while checking why a main source was dirty on a bead I
scoped measurement-only. ENDORSED -- do not undo it on account of that wording.

Extracting private[interview] clusterAssignments and having induce call it is the right move,
and for the reason your own comment gives: the fixture then exercises the SAME function induce
uses, rather than a reimplementation that can drift. That is the derived-over-synthesised
principle applied to a code path instead of to data, and it is a better reading of the bead than
the literal one I wrote. "Measurement only" meant do not change the placement arithmetic or the
thresholds; it did not mean never touch a main source. Your change alters no arithmetic.

I checked the one thing that could have bitten: after the refactor, `classes` is still used four
times in induce, so it is not dead, and clusterAssignments recomputing units and classes
internally is a small duplication that buys a clean read-only signature. Fine tradeoff, no action
needed. I am not asking for anything.

The acceptance bar from the bead still stands and it is the part I care about: the fixture must
PROVE it reached Ambiguous rather than assert it, and it must distinguish genuine two-way
continuity from a near-miss that routes elsewhere. Given you are now calling the real clustering
path, you are well placed to show the reached-branch evidence directly.
